change.description: Remove the Analytics Journal fact_json storage ceiling through a compatible forward migration while preserving existing public APIs and source facts.
change.release_unit_description: C18 Analytics Journal complete inline payload storage migration

planned.reasoning: No HTTP/SSE or typed public API changes are in scope. The candidate reads the supported legacy Journal shapes, preserves old fields and identities, and adds a forward storage form that remains readable by same-Major consumers.

scope_drift.description: The implementation remains limited to the owned SQLite Journal storage, migration tests, and migration records; typed ingestion, PostgreSQL, deployment, and production timing are unchanged.

current.reasoning: The forward copy preserves row identity, source envelope fields, event kind, payload bytes, indexes, sequence high-water, and surrounding analytics state. Older same-Major readers can read the canonical TEXT column; public response and wire contracts are unchanged.

public_api.supported_consumer_range: Existing same-Major HTTP/SSE clients and typed consumers; no public route, response, or configuration contract changes.

persistent_state.state_description: SQLite Analytics Journal events and its source envelope, event identity, state/coverage/snapshot/pin references, and AUTOINCREMENT sequence.
persistent_state.source_program_compatibility_range: Baseline dd6f108cc2796238c3c5dc4d7dad122a9df63275 and earlier supported 12-column Journal schemas with any declared compatibility-column subset; candidate and same-Major forward-repair readers.
